title: Fernando S NDE 5399
content: I was out with friends as a youngster when, driving down Lake Hill, the brakes of the VW Beetle we were in failed and we went straight into a rock. I was projected through the car windshield. I became aware that I was floating, entirely lucid but out of my body and completely conscious of what was going on. There were some other spirits or highly developed beings, but I didn’t know who they were. They were invisible to me although I could feel their presence. The feeling of peace was huge and transcendental, as I had never felt before. There were no signs of problems, anxiety or anguish. All my problems were gone. The surrounding environment of peace and serenity, which was a rose-whitish tone, worked as a profound magnetic field, which I was attracted to. I started moving towards it and knew intuitively, or something was telling me, that if I was to cross that frontier I would not be able to return. There was a barrier, putting a limit on life and death, and it was quite clear. At that moment, a voice in my mind was telling me that I should return because my objective in life was still pending. There was a lot to do yet. Immediately I felt a wish to return and, gaining consciousness, I found myself stuck into the car windshield. People around were trying to get me out of the car and I, showing an irrational strength and with an open wound in my neck, got out of the car by myself through the window and calmly walked to another vehicle and was driven to the hospital. Once I realized what had happened to me from the damage to my body I just panicked. At the hospital, I was told that the cut on my neck stopped only a couple of millimeters from a main artery, and that fact literally saved my life. I don’t know to what point there was some paranormal influence in keeping my body alive, but I believe I was given a second chance at life in order for me to accomplish my mission through an existence that I knew it would be neither easy nor simple. In spite of being aware of out of body experience since I was five years old, this particular one was the strongest of all my life.

arrival.other_being_detail: “some other spirits or highly developed beings… invisible to me although I could feel their presence.”

environment.environment_other_detail: A peaceful/serene surrounding environment described as a “rose-whitish tone,” like a “profound magnetic field” he was attracted to.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told to return because his “objective in life was still pending. There was a lot to do yet.” He later interprets this as being given “a second chance at life… to accomplish my mission.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car accident: VW Beetle brakes failed; crashed into a rock; he was projected through the windshield.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Strong peace/serenity; beings felt as invisible presences; “frontier”/barrier between life and death; inner voice instructing return due to pending life objective.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with peace/presence of beings and attraction toward rose-whitish serene environment, then boundary/frontier warning, then inner voice and return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He describes the peaceful environment as a “rose-whitish tone” that “worked as a profound magnetic field” attracting him; invisible beings whose presence could be felt.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I became aware that I was floating, entirely lucid but out of my body and completely conscious of what was going on.” “The feeling of peace was huge and transcendental…” “if I was to cross that frontier I would not be able to return.” “a voice in my mind was telling me that I should return because my objective in life was still pending.”
